workload.scope: Repeated warm prompts at concurrency one; no cold-prefill or concurrent-serving claim

measurement.cohort_policy: Every declared cohort is retained; no automatic retry or sample replacement; request failure invalidates the arm
measurement.headline: output_throughput tokens/s and mean_e2el_ms
measurement.statistics: Report all five cohort values; 10000 independent resamples of five whole cohorts per arm, seeded0, percentile95 CI of relative mean OTPS improvement; no token-level resampling

correctness.required: Exact prompt IDs, generated token IDs, finish and stop reasons, top5 token sets, and raw log probabilities over all 10 prompts and 32 outputs
correctness.baseline_repeat_rule: If A1/A2 differ, halt acceptance; diagnose before any candidate capture and record a new contract if needed. Never import standalone kernel tolerances.
correctness.reference_scope: Preserves the PR4 Neuron baseline. Its existing HF correctness shortfall remains open.

gates.performance: All requests complete with exact32 outputs, positive lower95 CI for mean OTPS improvement, candidate mean and p99 E2E latency improve, mean and p99 TTFT do not regress by more than5percent. Baseline post-control mean OTPS must be within5percent of initial A. Otherwise investigate and repeat full arms under a newly recorded attempt.
gates.compilation: Warm all workload graph shapes before measured cohorts; check compilation does not occur in timed windows
gates.same_runtime: Same Docker image ID, SDK and dependency overlay, weights, server config, KV block161, full16 devices. Distinct compile caches for A and B; post-A reuses A cache.
gates.dispatch: Capture source provenance and live loaded graph/NEFF evidence for both arms; candidate must exercise the fused MoE path
gates.expected_gain: Use separate full-model profile to estimate MoE critical-path share. A standalone kernel speedup is not an end-to-end prediction. If profile attribution is unavailable, report the expectation bound as unverified.

publish: Create a PR targeting campaign/glm-5.3-flash-port only if correctness preservation and repeatable full-model speedup pass. Do not claim upstream HF correctness or a general concurrency gain.
